title: VANTRUE N1 Pro Full HD 1920x1080P MINI Dashcam Product Review
description:
This video I am reviewing the N1 Pro Vantrue Mini Dashcam. The dashcam is front only and is much smaller compared to the other Vantrue products I own; N4 and N2S. It retails at $80 but with my affiliate code (REKOVTN) you can get 20% off on Vantrue’s official website. 

Introduction (20% off code) 00:14
Unboxing 00:35
Quick Start Guide 01:15
Unboxing Continued 01:43
Micro SD Card 03:33
Dash cam Settings 04:19
Dash cam controls 05:12
Dash cam Video Clips 06:40 
Conclusion 11:12

I got the product for free to give it my honest review and opinion. I was curious how it performed being only a front camera dashcam. It comes with an abundance of features for a small and compact dash cam such as parking mode(would require hardwiring to the car), GPS, speed monitor, FULL HD 1920x1080 30fps and more.

I thoroughly enjoyed the ease of use with the buttons and how clear it was in what button did what function. The save button is the red button on top and the others are next to the LCD screen. This dashcam seems ideal if you want a small portable dash cam or one on a budget for your first dashcam. If you’re able to, though, I would recommend investing in other Vantrue products such as the S1 Dash cam so you can get both front and back recording and higher resolutions.

In this video I purchased the 64gb Vantrue SD card (the dash cam supports up to 256gb micro sd card). They recommend their SD card with their dash cams which you can get at different sizes on their official website or Amazon. 64gb seemed fair for the N1 Pro since it’s only a front camera so there won’t be other cameras recording at the same time. For my N4 dashcam I use a 128gb though because I’m recording front, interior and rear simultaneously. 

Overall, I am appreciative of the N1 Pro’s compact design with ease of use for new owners. It offers a handful of features and good 1920x1080 quality for its price. Once you get get used to this dashcam, then you can look into multiple camera dashcams that Vantrue offers as well.
